description: Deterministic FactLot ID for a building from its street address: county FIPS, ZIP code, and street line. Every condominium unit, suite, and floor at the address gets the same building ID, offline. Pass it to id_space for a suite, or to registry_get to see the building's parcels.

state_fips.description: 2-digit state FIPS code, e.g. "11" for the District of Columbia.

street.description: Street line: house number and street, e.g. "208 Massachusetts Ave NE". A suite, unit or floor is ignored, and so is anything after a comma (city, state).

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the address, e.g. "20002" (ZIP+4 accepted).

name: id_building
title: FactLot building ID
